The text of the post remains as a semi-transparent overlay on top of the video clip.

audio_music: A quirky, instrumental track plays throughout. A high-pitched screeching or yelling sound effect is layered over the music, timed to coincide with the visual of Donald Trump making a gagging face. The overall effect is comical and mocking.

central_claim: Donald Trump's use of the sexually suggestive phrase 'full and deep throated' is inappropriate and absurd for an 80-year-old political figure.
intended_effect: To make the viewer mock Donald Trump for his choice of words and perceive him as strange or unfit for leadership.
